site.title: Agri Lacombe - Premium Local Farm Products
site.description: Agri Lacombe, a family farm near Saint-Mathias-sur-Richelieu, Quebec, offering sustainably grown asparagus, onions, garlic, pumpkins, and quality camping firewood.
hero.tagline: The Freshness of the Earth, from Our Family to Yours
hero.subtitle: Exceptional local vegetables and quality camping firewood, offered with passion and care in Saint-Mathias-sur-Richelieu, Quebec.

commitments.quality.text: An unwavering commitment to producing premium vegetables, season after season.

commitments.sustainability.text: Implementing environmentally friendly farming practices to preserve our land.

commitments.innovation.text: Optimizing resources and workflows through technology and smart planning.
products.title: Our Farm Products
products.asparagus.title: Fresh Quebec Asparagus
products.asparagus.description_short: Tender, flavorful spears, harvested fresh from our Quebec fields.
products.onions.title: Sweet & Savory Spanish Onions
products.onions.description_short: Large, mild, and juicy onions perfect for a variety of culinary uses.
products.onions.availability: Available from August to October (and in storage).
products.redOnions.title: Fresh & Crisp Red Onions
products.redOnions.description_short: Delicious red onions that add both flavor and color to all your recipes.
products.garlic.title: Quebec-Grown Music Garlic
products.garlic.description_short: Large, easy-to-peel cloves with a rich, bold flavor that keeps for months.
products.garlicScapes.title: Quebec-Grown Music Garlic Scapes
products.garlicScapes.description_short: The tender curly stems of our Music garlic, picked in early summer: a mild garlic flavor, perfect in pesto, stir-fries or on the grill.
products.garlicScapes.availability: Available from late June to July.
products.pumpkins.title: Local Orange Pumpkins
products.pumpkins.description_short: Perfect for Halloween decorations and delicious in all your orange soups and sauces.
products.campingFirewood.title: Ready-to-Burn Camping Firewood
products.campingFirewood.description_sho: Dry, split firewood ready for your campfires and evenings outdoors.
